name: HybridRAG-Bench
description:
HybridRAG-Bench Dataset
	

HybridRAG-Bench is a benchmark dataset for studying multi-hop reasoning over hybrid knowledge:

Unstructured text: arXiv paper markdown files and QA pairs
Structured knowledge graphs: Neo4j-exported node/edge parquet files

The benchmark is designed for retrieval-augmented evaluation (RAG, KG-RAG, hybrid methods) where all QA items are treated as test queries.
